map.→ 打开保洁任务分配工具: -> Open the cleaning task assignment tool
map.人员不够怎么调？: What if there is not enough staff?
map.优先保 hard 区域达标，medium 区域可合并或降频，并用排班表公示，避免: Prioritise getting hard zones to standard, allow medium zones to be merged or less frequent, and publish the schedule so nothing is missed and complaints avoided.
map.按区域面积与难度计算工作量，均衡分配给保洁人员: Computes workload from area and difficulty and balances the allocation across cleaning staff
map.按脏污频率与清洁耗时：电梯、车库为 hard，大堂、楼道为 medium，办公室: By soiling frequency and cleaning time: lifts and car parks are hard, lobbies and corridors are medium, offices are easy.
map.新员工上岗按轻难度区域起步，逐步加量: New staff start with low-difficulty zones and build up the workload gradually
map.物业保洁主管按各区域面积与脏污难度把任务派给保洁员: A property cleaning supervisor assigns tasks to cleaners by the area and soiling difficulty of each zone
map.节假日或活动前临时增加重点区域频次: Temporarily raise the frequency of key zones before holidays or events
map.输入各清洁区域面积与清洁难度系数，工具折算标准工作量并均衡分配给多名保洁人员，输: Enter the area and cleaning difficulty coefficient for each zone; the tool converts to standard workload, balances it across several cleaners and outputs the zones and hours per person, so property management can schedule fairly by area and difficulty and avoid overloading staff.
map.：活动日大堂保洁频次由 1 次/日提到 3 次/日，相应工时 ×3，需从其他区域: : on an event day the lobby cleaning frequency rises from 1 to 3 times per day, so hours triple; 0.5 person is borrowed from other zones and the schedule is posted publicly.
map.：电梯轿厢×2（20 ㎡/个，hard）、大堂（300 ㎡，medium）、楼道: : two lift cars ×2 (20 m² each, hard), lobby (300 m², medium), corridors (600 m², medium), underground car park (1500 m², hard) → weighting by difficulty (hard costs 2x per m²) assigns 2 people to the car park and 3 people to the rest.
